findings.message: L30-31: 🔵 nit: 'The App and its Worker never hold, see, proxy or log a customer OPENROUTER_API_KEY'. Missing serial comma before 'or'. Add comma: 'hold, see, proxy, or log'.

L23: ❓ q: '--repo <owner/name>: confirms the target. It must match the checkout's origin; it cannot redirect the push.' The phrase 'it cannot redirect the push' is ambiguous. Clarify: if --repo does not match, the command fails; push goes to origin not to --repo.
L36: ❓ q: 'The command never reads, prints or transmits OPENROUTER_API_KEY.' Missing serial comma: 'reads, prints, or transmits'. See also SECURITY.md finding.
